Name: Fat Bat Coop Animal
Author: Campaigner
Description:
==================
WHAT IS THIS?
==================
This mod introduces a single coop animal to Marnie's Ranch; the fat bat! As its name implies, this chunky chiroptera is a round bat that's a bit too heavy to fly. When this lovably pudgy critter is in your coop, it'll somehow smuggle in a random seasonal fruit, including tree fruits and foraged fruits! How does it smuggle the fruit, you might ask? Nobody knows! It always happens when you're asleep, the crafty little thing.


==================
REQUIRED MODS
==================
"Content Patcher" by Pathoschild
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915 [/url]
- Required


==================
SUGGESTED MODS
==================
"Animal Squeeze Through" by zombifier
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33514]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33514 [/url]
- Allows Fat Bat to exit the coop if installed.


==================
KNOWN ISSUES:
==================
None so far! Let me know in the comments section if you run into any issues! Be sure to run your error log through SMAPI's log parser tool as well, otherwise I might not know how to fix the issue. The log parser can be found at SMAPI's official site: https://smapi.io/log

Downloads.Description:
Initial Release.
Reminder: It CANNOT exit the coop without the mod "Animal Squeeze Through" by zombifier!
